page.layout: Three blocks: a left column of marginal-style summary entries (seven entries, each its own paragraph); a central column of names in seven groups separated by rules; a right column of years, one per group, beside the names. Page number at the top right.

main_text.p: Actio de reconciliatione inter partes Monasterii: & alia Adoardiæ. EDSARDO proscriptio denunciata.
Edsardus, item Groningani proscripti. Bellum atrox cis ultraq; Amasum illatum. DAMMONA à Saxonibus vi capta, Groninga iuris GEL-DRICI facta.
Ius Frisicum à Georgio Saxone in Carolum Bvrg.pr. translatum : bellum inter Burgundos & Geldros in Frisia occid. gesum.
Bellum idem continuatum Doccumum à Burgundis captum.
Edsardus Maximiliano Cæs. & Burgundicis reconciliatus: Bolsverdia à Burgundicis capta: SNECA obsessa. Longus PIERVS Hollandorum terror. Doccumum à Geldricis receptum.
Edsardus cum Brunsuigiis & Saxonibus transfegit, arceinq; Stichusam recepit.

page.notes: The years 1513–1519 stand in the right column beside the groups of names; each is written after the first name of its group. The name lists are in italic type. The word "obsessa" is printed as "obfesfa" and is read as obsessa; the reading is probable but not certain. Hyphenated words GEL-DRICI and Gronin-ganis are kept at their printed line ends. A small stray mark sits at the bottom left of the page and is not printed text.
